verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this axis is that Kong documents an official Kong Konnect MCP Server. That suggests an external AI agent or MCP client could operate Konnect through natural-language prompts, but the evidence gives only a title and URL, with no description of which operations it exposes. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language assistant or command interface in Kong Gateway, Konnect or Kong Manager. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP server exposes for natural-language control, coverage of self-hosted Gateway (not just Konnect), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
